senses.gloss:
r. 10th cl. (तुत्थयति)
1 To screen, to veil, to cover.
2 To spread.

m. (-त्थः)
Fire.
f. (-त्था)
1 Indigo.
2 Small cardamoms.
n. (-त्थं)
1 A collyrium extracted from the Amomum zanthorrhiza.
2 Blue vitriol, sulphate of copper, especially medicinally considered as an Añjana, or application to the eyes.
E.
तुद to pain, थक् Uṇādi aff.

n. (-कं)
Blue vitriol.
E.
कन् added to तुत्थ.

n. (-नं)
Blue vitriol, considered as a medicinal application to the eyes.
E.
तुत्थ the same, and अञ्जन a collyrium.
